title: Certificate of Insurance (ACORD 25 Certificate of Liability Insurance)

certificate_date.description: Date the certificate was issued, from the DATE (MM/DD/YYYY) box at the top right, exactly as printed.

certificate_number.description: Certificate number printed beside CERTIFICATE NUMBER above the coverages grid, or null if blank.

form_edition.description: ACORD form number and edition printed in the footer, e.g. ACORD 25 (2016/03).

producer.description: The broker or agency that issued the certificate (PRODUCER box).

name.description: Producer organization name, including any 'Div of' line, as printed.

address.description: Producer mailing address as one string: street or PO box, city, state and ZIP.

contact_name.description: Name in the CONTACT NAME box, or null if blank.

phone.description: Number in the PHONE (A/C, No, Ext) box, or null if blank.

fax.description: Number in the FAX (A/C, No) box, or null if blank.

email.description: Address in the E-MAIL ADDRESS box, or null if blank.

address.description: Insured mailing address as one string: street, city, state and ZIP.

insurers.description: Insurers listed under INSURER(S) AFFORDING COVERAGE. Include only lettered rows that name an insurer; skip blank rows.

naic_number.description: NAIC number printed in the NAIC # column for this insurer, or null if blank.

coverages.description: One entry per coverage row in the COVERAGES grid that carries a policy number. Skip coverage rows (auto, umbrella, workers compensation) that are blank.

coverage_type.description: Type of insurance for the row, e.g. Commercial General Liability, Professional Liability.

insurer_letter.description: Letter in the INSR LTR column for this row.

effective_date.description: POLICY EFF date for this row, exactly as printed.

expiration_date.description: POLICY EXP date for this row, exactly as printed.

occurrence_basis.description: For general liability: 'occurrence' or 'claims-made' according to the checked box; null if neither or not applicable.

aggregate_limit_applies_per.description: For general liability: which GEN'L AGGREGATE LIMIT APPLIES PER box is checked (policy, project or location); null if none or not applicable.

limits.description: Limits printed in the LIMITS column for this row. Include only limits that carry an amount or a word such as EXCLUDED.

name.description: Limit label, e.g. EACH OCCURRENCE, GENERAL AGGREGATE, Each Wrongful Act.

amount.description: Amount or wording printed for the limit, exactly as printed, e.g. 1,000,000 or EXCLUDED.

description_of_operations.description: Full text of the DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS / LOCATIONS / VEHICLES box, or null if blank.

certificate_holder.description: Name and address in the CERTIFICATE HOLDER box as one string, or null if the box is blank.

authorized_representative_signed.description: True if the AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE box carries a signature.
